task: SMALL CI REPAIR — the DSH-Go kit checkout step in both workflows
head: d65bc680

failedRun.cause: actions/checkout refuses any `path:` that resolves outside $GITHUB_WORKSPACE. `${{ runner.temp }}` expands to /home/runner/work/_temp, which is a SIBLING of the workspace (/home/runner/work/My-Power-Dsh), never a descendant — so the step died before any gate ran.

resolverContract.meaning: MPD_DSHGO_KIT names the dsh-Go CHECKOUT ROOT (not the plugin-kit subdirectory). A direct kit directory also resolves, through the second candidate. Both workflows therefore export the checkout ROOT: $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.dsh-go-kit.
resolverContract.unsetBehaviour: CROSS-CHECK lane NOT-PASSED and RESULT NOT-PASSED, exit 3 — unchanged by this repair
